newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa taken to hospital after fall.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa taken to hospital after fall.

text.p: Mother Teresa was rushed to hospital on Monday after falling down and hurting her head, hospital officials and an aide said.

The legendary Roman Catholic nun was taken to the intensive cardiac care unit of Woodlands Nursing Home in the eastern Indian city of Calcutta after falling down at her Missionaries of Charity religious order, they said.
A nun told Reuters that after the fall, Mother Teresa appeared dazed for about 10 minutes before being taken to hospital.
Mother Teresa, 86, recently spent 18 days in the same hospital with heart trouble, malaria and pneumonia. She spent most of the time on a respirator.
Known as the Saint of the Gutters for her devotion to the poor and destitute, Mother Teresa was released on September 6, but doctors advised her to rest in bed.
Mother Teresa, winner of 1979 Nobel Peace Prize, was fitted with a cardiac pacemaker in 1989.
